messages:
support_alex: Heads up — Spaceshop (org: spaceshop-prod) opened a ticket: console streaming metrics (TTFT / tokens/sec) showing negative numbers and weird billing spikes after the 09:01 deploy. Customer attached screenshot and says some calls were billed twice. Ticket INC-827. Can we triage?

eng-oncall_jamie: seeing it in prod dashboards too. tokens/sec graph goes from ~1200 -> -400 for ~2m then back. TTFT spike and negative rollup deltas.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: service=metrics-aggregator env=prod sha=abc123 at 2026-03-10T09:01:12Z -- feature_flag: allow_counter_wrap=true

eng-infra_maya: I restarted the kafka consumer group metrics-rollup at 09:01 to land the new topic config (rolling restart). Consumer logs show a commit reset on shard 7 around 09:01:18. Possible out-of-order checkpoint leading to negative deltas.

sre_lan: Can you paste the query you're using? PromQL/SQL?

support_alex: PromQL we used for the console: increase(redwood_streaming_tokens_total{env="prod"}[1m])  -> dashboard rollup aggregates per-host then sums. Running raw increase() over the timeframe returns negative deltas for a few hosts. Example sample: host=host-7 delta = -1234 at 09:01:20.

eng-runtime_sara: noted. We merged a change earlier this week to convert delta calculation to signed 32-bit -> signed wrap handling when allow_counter_wrap=true is enabled. Looks like for very large counters the signed cast can produce negative numbers if not handled correctly. If the consumer restarted and offset/sequence resets happened we can see a negative increase.

eng-oncall_jamie: Repro steps I ran locally against the metric store:
```
SELECT host, curr, prev, curr - prev AS delta
FROM (SELECT host, value AS curr, LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY ts) AS prev FROM streaming_counters WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T08:59:30Z' AND '2026-03-10T09:02:00Z')
WHERE delta < 0;
```
This shows several rows for host-7 and host-12 negative due to prev > curr.

eng-infra_maya: consumer commit log snippet: `consumer-group metrics-rollup committed offset 2048 -> reset to 0 on partition 7 due to config change`. That lines up with the negative delta windows.

eng-runtime_sara: I'm going to roll back the allow_counter_wrap flag on the aggregator-prod to force the old safe path (clamps wraps to positive) and deploy a patch to clamp negative deltas to 0 in the rollup pipeline. Doing rollback now (ETA ~15-30m).

product_ana: Customer is worried about billing. We should proactively validate invoices for Spaceshop for the window 08:50-09:10 UTC and prepare credits if necessary. Also need a short customer-friendly explanation.

finance_maria: If metrics were negative that means the rollup produced incorrect per-customer token counts. Please provide list of request_ids or aggregated usage by customer for 08:50-09:10 so we can identify misbilled lines. We'll hold billing for that org until resolved. :money_with_wings:

support_alex: Providing sample request ids: r_abc123, r_def456, r_ghi789 (from ticket). Screenshot attached in the ticket. I'll message Spaceshop to say we're investigating and holding billing while we confirm.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: service=metrics-aggregator env=prod action=rollback feature_flag:allow_counter_wrap=false at 2026-03-10T09:15:02Z

eng-runtime_sara: Rollback complete. I've also pushed a quick hotfix to clamp negative deltas at the rollup stage and added a unit test for signed->unsigned handling. Patch PR: github.com/redwood/metrics/pull/452 (hotfix).

sre_lan: Monitoring shows tokens/sec and TTFT back to expected positive values across hosts; negative deltas window resolved. Charts normalized ~09:18 UTC. Marking incident as mitigated. :thumbsup:

eng-infra_maya: Follow-up: we'll add a pre-commit check in the consumer restart script to snapshot offsets and avoid resets when feature flags toggle topics. Also scheduling a runbook update.

product_ana: I'll draft the customer note and propose a partial credit for Spaceshop. Support, please wait for finance confirmation before sending the credit amount.

finance_maria: We'll calculate the credit and confirm by EOD.

support_alex: I'll close the ticket after postmortem and confirm credits. Root cause summary for postmortem: feature flag + 32-bit signed delta handling bug + coincident kafka consumer restart caused negative deltas to appear in rollup -> wrong tokens/sec and a potential billing overcount.

eng-runtime_sara: Will file the postmortem doc and assign owners (runtime + infra) to the fixes. ETA for full fix (robust wrap handling + extra tests): 3 business days.

support_alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update INC-827 and notify Spaceshop once finance confirms the credit. :rotating_light:
